items.claim: Jackson McVey has more knockout power in his striking compared to Wes Schultz.
items.quote: Striking for striking comparison between these two, you got to lean Jackson McVey just because he has more knockout power.

items.claim: Jackson McVey tends to fatigue badly after the first round.
items.quote: Anytime he wins a fight, three KOs in the very first round, four subs in the very first round. If they make it out of that first round, he's losing.

items.claim: Jackson McVey took his previous fight against Zack Reese on short notice.
items.quote: Zack Reese took this fight on short notice and Jackson McVey was the one who deathgasted after the first round.

items.claim: Jackson McVey was submitted in the first round by Bruno Ferrer.
items.quote: getting armarded in the first round by Bruno Ferrer is kind of crazy.
I have real concerns for the durability.

items.claim: Chanel Dyer's grappling is pretty much untested.
Elise Reed's durability is not good overall.
items.quote: At least Reed her durability is not good overall.

items.claim: Elise Reed has a record of 0-2 by submission.
items.quote: Her record to the sub is 0 and2.
